metadata.title: Basic Series: Part 3 - Beginning Descendancy Research - James Tanner
metadata.author: BYU Library Family History Center
metadata.shortDescription:
This webinar goes over how to get started with descendancy research and why it is beneficial.
For more information: https://familyhistory.lib.byu.edu/all-webinars/basic-series-part-3-beginning-descendancy-research
